title: Welcome to December at The Anchor
preheader: Three nights out, the last Christmas sittings, and our hours over the festive fortnight.

data.alt: The Anchor, Stanwell Moor Village, since 1751. Holly, pine cones and Christmas greenery around the wordmark.

data.heading: Welcome to December
body: Three nights out before Christmas, the last of the Christmas sittings, and then the quiet stretch between the years when the bar is open and the kitchen has earned a rest.
Our hours change over the festive fortnight, so they are set out in full further down. If you are booking a Christmas meal, 20 December is the last sitting.

events.name: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night
events.detail: 7pm start, £3 cash on arrival, teams of up to six. A gentle festive nod, not a themed quiz.

image.alt: Tinsel and Trivia Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

events.name: Sleigh My Name Festive Music Bingo
events.detail: 7pm start, £5 cash on arrival. Two themed rounds of festive songs, Nikki hosting.

image.alt: Sleigh My Name festive music bingo at The Anchor

events.name: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo
events.detail: 7pm start, £10 cash a book. Ten games, a rollover Snowball and a cash jackpot at the end.

image.alt: Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.heading: Our usual week
data.footnote: These are our hours up to and including Monday 21 December. The dates that differ are listed below.

data.heading: Christmas and New Year

rows.note: Christmas Day, drinks only. Happy Christmas from all of us

data.footnote: Any date not listed runs our usual hours above. The kitchen is back to normal on Tuesday 12 January.

image.alt: A Sunday roast at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

cards.heading: Sunday roast
cards.body: 1pm to 6pm every Sunday up to 20 December, last seating 5.30pm. Nothing to pre-order.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner laid out at The Anchor

cards.heading: Last Christmas sittings
cards.body: The final sitting is Sunday 20 December. From four guests up, with a £10 per person deposit.

data.script_line: Happy Christmas from all of us
data.body: Thank you for a good year. Whether we see you at the quiz, at a Christmas table or on a quiet afternoon in between, you are welcome.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
